newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Michael Hill expanding in Australia.
newsitem.headline: Michael Hill expanding in Australia.

text.p: Australia will continue to be the focus of expansion for jewellery chain Michael Hill International, according to the company's annual report published on Wednesday.
The chain sees prospects for an additional 23 shops in its key Queensland, Victoria and New South Wales markets.
More than 100 Michael Hill shops could eventually dot the Australian retailing landscape, up from current 47.

Seven Australian stores were opened in the 1996 financial year, compared with four in New Zealand, bringing the New Zealand total to 35. The company plans two additional New Zealand outlets this year.
In August, the group reported a net profit for 1995 of NZ$5.3 million, up fron $4.21 million the previous year.
Michael Hill shops reduced gross profit margins "slightly" during the first six months of the year to meet sales targets.
The report says company founder Michael Hill was paid $263,000 for the year.
The company's annual meeting will be held at Pakatoa Island on November 8.
